messages:
maya: Quick sync — need to lock Q2 scope for text-gen + embeddings. I sketched three slices: 1) latency/cost wins for completions, 2) embeddings quality + deterministic outputs for enterprise, 3) rerank beta. Which do we prioritize?
jordan: For engineering: completions latency improvements are doable in Q2 if we accept a partial rollout (canary) and no new model architectures. Main work: batching & kernel tuning. Estimate: 6 wks.
sam: From eval side: embeddings quality work (small-model fine-tuning + calibration) is higher risk/time. Also need dedicated eval sets per customer segment to avoid regressions. Would be ~8-10 wks if we include offline finetune path.
anita: Sales input: two F100 customers asked for deterministic embeddings + max 5ms lookup variability. They'd pay for dedicated capacity. Embeddings reliability is a clear upsell.
lee: SDK / migration note: any deterministic change means a minor SDK bump and a migration guide. We should allocate 1 sprint for deprecation warnings and docs.
maya: Proposal: prioritize embeddings reliability (slice A) as revenue-enabler, while doing a concurrent completions perf spike (slice B) but as best-effort. Rerank (slice C) deferred unless partner pilot signs. Thoughts?
jordan: +1 for embeddings first if sales can commit. For perf spike we can target kernel-level optimizations and KV cache tuning. Need capacity for canary traffic.
anita: I'll push for a letter of intent from the two customers. If we get LOI, prioritize embeddings and private deployment gating.
sam: Can we scope embeddings reliability into two milestones? M1: deterministic hashes + stable dimension mapping (no model changes) — 4 wks. M2: quality finetune + evals — another 6 wks. That gives quick win while deferring heavier work.
maya: Good — let's adopt M1/M2. M1 becomes Q2 must-have. M2 optional based on LOI.
jordan: Resource ask: need one infra engineer + one ml infra for M1, then bring in mlof for M2. Also need a perf engineer for completions spike.
lee: I'll draft the SDK and docs tickets: migration guide, changelog, sample code. Quick snippet for canary config I'll add to the ticket: 
```
CANARY_PERCENT=10
MODEL_VARIANT=emb-v1-stable
ROUTER_POLICY=loyalty:region
```
maya: Launch criteria for M1 (embeddings deterministic):
- automated tests for hash stability across releases
- canary serving at 10% traffic for 2 weeks with no regressions
- SDK docs + migration guide published
- legal/contract addendum template for dedicated capacity
- customer LOI or pilot sign-up (preferred, not blocking)
jordan: Add infra SLOs: p95 latency <= 50ms for embeddings 90% of time, 99th <= 200ms for dedicated pools. Also cost estimate per embedding unit change.
sanity-check by sam: must include eval pass rate >= baseline on our benchmark suites (semantic-sim, recall), otherwise rollback.
anita: Sales will accept a pilot LOI as sign-up. I'll coordinate with Customer Success for pilot onboarding checklist.
release-bot: Deploy plan queued: 2 canary clusters, alerting hooks, rollback playbook. See https://internal/release/1812340000
maya: Ok action items: anita -> LOI follow-ups; jordan -> infra plan + cost; sam -> eval M1 suite; lee -> SDK + docs; set a decision deadline: next Wed (1812426400). Please put blockers in this thread. :eyes:
jordan: Noted. I'll flag compute availability if Dedicated pool needs new hardware.
sam: Adding small eval run tonight to baseline current embeddings. Will post results here.
anita: I'll ping the two contacts this afternoon.
lee: Drafting the migration guide now, will link when ready.
maya: Thanks all. If we get LOI, we'll flip priorities. Otherwise proceed with M1 + perf spike best-effort. :thumbsup:
